questions.label: Where cookies are set
questions.ask: Where does your company set cookies?
options: A widget or script embedded on customers' sites
questions.fills: Cookie: Where we place cookies (replaces the Automattic site list)
questions.codebase: Domains and subdomains in site config, deployment config and embed scripts.

questions.label: Required cookies
questions.ask: What do your essential cookies do?
options: Remember settings such as language or theme
Security, such as CSRF and fraud protection
questions.fills: Cookie: Types of Cookie (Required) and Examples
questions.codebase: Session and auth library config, cookies().set, res.cookie or document.cookie calls, CSRF middleware.

questions.label: Analytics cookies
questions.ask: Which analytics tools set cookies or similar identifiers?
questions.fills: Cookie: Types of Cookie (Analytics and Performance) and Controlling Cookies opt-out links
questions.codebase: Analytics SDK initialization and script tags in the root layout; check whether cookies or localStorage are disabled.

questions.label: Product event tracking
questions.ask: Do you record product events such as page views and clicks tied to a user's account?
options: Yes, events are linked to the account
Yes, but only anonymous or aggregated
questions.fills: Cookie: Our Internal Analytics Tool (adapt or remove)
questions.codebase: track(), capture() or identify() calls in analytics code.

questions.label: Advertising cookies
questions.ask: Do you use advertising or retargeting cookies?
options: Ad and retargeting pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn)
questions.fills: Cookie: Types of Cookie (Advertising); remove the Automattic ads program sections either way
questions.codebase: Pixel scripts in page markup or tag manager config.

questions.label: Other third-party cookies
questions.ask: Which other third-party services can set cookies on your pages?
questions.fills: Cookie: Examples and third-party cookie sections
questions.codebase: Widget and embed scripts, checkout redirects, iframe embeds.

questions.label: Cookie consent
questions.ask: How do visitors consent to non-essential cookies?
options: Banner asks first; nothing optional loads until they accept
Banner with a link to opt out
No banner; we only use essential cookies
questions.fills: Cookie: Consent sections and Controlling Cookies
questions.codebase: Consent banner component or SDK (Reconform, Cookiebot, OneTrust) and whether scripts wait for consent.

questions.label: Level of detail
questions.ask: Should the policy list each cookie by name?
options: List each cookie with its name, provider and purpose
Describe categories and name the providers only
questions.codebase: Cookie names set in code and by the SDKs found above.
